value: rvr init scans codebase via scanCodebase() in src/commands/scan.ts — 6 composable detectors (detectProject, detectCommands, detectFiles, detectDeps, detectConventions, detectContext). Generates CLAUDE.md via src/commands/claude-md.ts AND (since #117 WS2) an agent-agnostic AGENTS.md (CLI-driven workflow, CLI_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS-flavored) via generateAgentsMd in the same file. Seeds conventions.persistence entry. Flags: --no-scan, --no-claude, --no-agents, --force, --dry-run. Idempotent — skips existing keys/files.
